name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a development-stage precious metals company advancing its flagship Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project is fully permitted with a completed Definitive Feasibility Study outlining a 25-year mine life and first production targeted for 2029. The company also trades on the OTCQX under the symbol ABBRF and continues exploration drilling to expand the resource.
